findings.where: src/app/globals.css:2035-2039 (.code-block pre); e.g. http://localhost:3300/learn/lab-gated-pipeline and /learn/undo-and-conflicts at 390, 768, 1024 and 1440
findings.problem: Code blocks with a Copy button reserve `padding-right: 6.5rem` on every line and use `white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere` with no hanging indent. When a command wraps, its tail looks like a separate command. Repro: on /learn/lab-gated-pipeline, Try step 1 is `git clone https://github.com/bradtraversy/cicd-lab-starter.git cicd-lab`. At 1440 and 1024, `cicd-lab` sits alone on the line above `cd cicd-lab`. At 768 the URL breaks after `cicd-lab-`. At 390 the line splits into five: `git clone` / `https://github.com` / `/bradtraversy/cicd` / `-lab-starter.git` / `cicd-lab`. On /learn/undo-and-conflicts at 390, the first block's 6 commands render as 12 lines: `mkdir undo-` / `practice`, `git add` / `pancakes.md`, `git commit -m "Add` / `pancakes"`. A beginner typing along would run `cicd-lab` or `pancakes.md` as commands. Across all 79 lessons at 390, 109 source lines in 57 blocks in 15 lessons wrap; 75 of them are shell commands, some taking up to 5 visual lines. At 768, 22 lines wrap in 10 lessons; at 1440, 16 lines in 8 lessons.
findings.fix: Stop reserving the Copy button's width on every line. Move the button into a strip above the code (e.g. `.code-block { padding-top: 2.25rem }`, button at the top right) and drop the pre's `padding-right`. Then make wrapped tails unmistakable, either way works: (a) keep `white-space: pre` with `overflow-x: auto` so each command stays on one scrollable line, or (b) render each source line as a block span with a hanging indent (`padding-left: 2ch; text-indent: -2ch`) so wrapped tails are visibly indented. Re-check the undo-and-conflicts block at 390.

findings.where: src/app/learn/[slug]/quick-check-rail.tsx:65-87 (place: tops/floor/minHeight; every marked Section gets data-rail) and src/app/learn/[slug]/section.tsx:96 (data-quick-checks); e.g. http://localhost:3300/learn/gates#practice and /learn/agents-in-github-actions#six-safety-rules-before-you-switch-one-on at 1280 and 1440
findings.problem: From 1280px, QuickCheckRail lifts every Quick check in a marked Section into the ~383px right column and stacks them. When checks come back to back (Practice sections) or close together, the stack runs far past the text. The Section's min-height then grows to hold it, leaving the text column blank. Repro at 1440: /learn/gates#practice is a heading plus one sentence, followed by 8 checks stacked down the narrow right column, leaving about 2,630px of empty left column. /learn/agents-in-github-actions#six-safety-rules… leaves 3,490px blank (3,660px at 1280), and its last check (rule-auto-merge) sits 3,099px below the sentence it tests. Measured over all lessons at 1280, 33 sections in 22 lessons have over 1,000px of blank text column (19 sections in 15 lessons at 1440), and 89 sections have over 600px (73 at 1440). Examples: wayfinder-first-session#practice 2,271px, answers-from-other-people#practice 1,886px, implement#practice-scenarios 1,673px, what-ci-cd-is#ci-merge-often-check-every-change 1,182px, where checks sit beside unrelated paragraphs. Below 1280 the same checks read fine inline at full width. No checks overlap, even after answering.
findings.fix: Use the margin only when the stack fits beside its text. In place(), compare the stacked bottom with the last text block's bottom, or each check's distance from its anchor. If it overshoots by more than about one check's height, or any check lands more than ~300px below its anchor, leave that Section inline: don't set data-rail on it, set no tops and no minHeight. Its numeral stage then comes back. A simpler option: in LessonSection, don't set data-quick-checks on Sections whose checks are a run of 2 or more with no text between them (the Practice and Practice scenarios Sections), so they stay in the text column.

findings.where: src/app/globals.css:353-366 (.photo-band::before scrim, only 0.25 alpha at 75% height), :1462 (.breadcrumb a, amber) and :379 (.photo-band .eyebrow, amber); e.g. http://localhost:3300/learn/implement-spec, /learn/calling-a-model and /courses/foundations at 390 and 1440
findings.problem: The amber breadcrumb (0.82rem / 13.9px bold capitals) and the amber 'Course N of 7' eyebrow sit near the top of the hero text block, where the scrim is only about 25% dark, so on bright photos they all but disappear. I hid the text and sampled the rendered photo pixels behind each text box. The breadcrumb fails 4.5:1 on 55 of 77 photo Lesson heroes at 390 and 48 at 1440, and falls below 2:1 on 26 and 20 of them. It is about 1.1:1, effectively invisible, on /learn/retro, /learn/lab-gated-pipeline, /learn/implement-spec and /learn/scaffold-exercises at 390, and on /learn/implement-spec, /learn/diagnosing-bugs and /learn/calling-a-model at 1440 (on calling-a-model, 'FOUNDATIONS' vanishes into the white radio dish). The Course eyebrow measures 1.57:1 on /courses/foundations, 1.69:1 on /courses/idea-to-shipped and 1.99:1 on /courses/ci-cd at 1440. The home hero's 'Free · No account needed' is 2.64:1 at 390, and the white h1 on /courses/foundations drops to 2.9:1 at 390.
findings.fix: Darken the scrim across the whole text block instead of only the bottom 40%. For example, on .lesson-hero and .course-hero: `linear-gradient(to top, rgb(5 10 25/.9) 0%, rgb(5 10 25/.72) 60%, rgb(5 10 25/.5) 100%)`, and a near-uniform ~0.75 at ≤640px, where the text fills the band. Alternatively, give the breadcrumb and eyebrow their own backing (`background: rgb(5 10 25/.7); padding: .15em .45em; box-decoration-break: clone`). Re-measure until every hero breadcrumb and eyebrow reaches at least 4.5:1.

findings.where: src/app/globals.css:3814-3822 ([data-reveal-state="hidden"] { opacity: 0 } applies to print too) with src/app/reveal.tsx; e.g. http://localhost:3300/learn/tdd
findings.problem: Reveal marks everything below the first screen `data-reveal-state="hidden"`, and the `opacity: 0; transform` rule is not limited to screen, so it also applies when printing. Repro: open /learn/tdd at 1280x900, don't scroll, and press Ctrl+P or Save as PDF. Page 1 has the hero and three paragraphs; pages 2-8 and beyond are blank. In print emulation, 77 blocks holding 66% of the lesson's text (14,291 of 21,689 characters) have opacity 0. Separately, the hero's white h1 and lead print as faint grey on white, because there are no print styles and backgrounds aren't printed by default.
findings.fix: Limit the hidden state to screen: `@media screen and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { [data-reveal-state="hidden"] {…} }`, or add `@media print { [data-reveal-state] { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important } }`. Optionally, mark everything shown on `beforeprint` in reveal.tsx. Add minimal print colours for .photo-band text: ink on white, no text-shadow.

result.summary:
I tested the production build at http://localhost:3300 in Playwright and found four real defects, all medium. Everything else I checked works.

**Programmatic checks**
- **All 89 pages (home, 7 Courses, 79 Lessons, /credits, /progress):**
  - No horizontal scroll at 375px, and none at 390, 768, 1024, 1280 or 1440 either.
  - No console errors or failed requests, and no broken images. The one exception is `/api/comments`, which returns 500 on every Lesson. That is the sandbox: it can't reach the Neon database ("fetch failed"), and the page shows its designed "Couldn't load comments." message.
- **All 79 Lessons** have a Final test with 5-10 questions and a Submit test button. Results are in `crawl.json` in the review folder.
- **Margin-rail Quick checks** never overlap each other, the text or the next Section, including after answering. The only alignment problem is the blank-column one in UI-2.

**Screenshots** (deviceScaleFactor 1, at 1440, 1024, 768 and 390; 1200 and 1100 spot-checked for the two-column band below the rail):
- Home (full page), /courses/github-basics, /courses/foundations, /credits and /progress.
- 11 Lessons covering every block kind in use: tdd, what-ci-cd-is, reading-a-workflow, context-window, lab-gated-pipeline, start-here, branches-and-worktrees, issues-and-keeping-track, wayfinder-first-session, how-agents-work and instruction-files.
- That covers goals, every diagram type (chain, compare, tree, layers nested and stacked, git, cycle), the meter Scene, the big-idea stage, remember and watch-out callouts, Try, code, tables, flashcards, sources, discussion and prev/next. No lesson uses the tip callout or site-story.
- States, all of which render correctly at every width:
  - a Quick check answered right and wrong, in the rail and inline;
  - the Final test nudge and sticky bar, the Done banner, a graded question, and the banner after a reload;
  - flashcards flipped;
  - the Done pill in the lesson hero, the Done tick on the Course page, the "Continue" button, and the home Continue card;
  - /progress with progress, the reset confirmation and the reset message.

**Defects found**
1. **Wrapped commands look like separate commands (UI-1).** Copy-button code blocks wrap long commands with no indent, so the tail reads as a new command. At 390, 75 command lines across 15 Lessons are affected, and it still happens at 1440.
2. **Blank text column beside the margin rail (UI-2).** From 1280px, Practice sections and other runs of back-to-back Quick checks stack down the narrow right column. This leaves over 1,000px of empty text column in 33 sections across 22 Lessons at 1280, up to about 3,600px.
3. **Unreadable amber hero text (UI-3).** The breadcrumb and Course eyebrow over bright photos fail 4.5:1 contrast on 55 of 77 Lesson heroes at 390 and 48 at 1440, and many are nearly invisible.
4. **Printing a Lesson gives blank pages (UI-4).** Content that hasn't been scrolled into view keeps its `opacity: 0` reveal state in print.

**Evidence** is in `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/74a692da-26dd-57ab-b4f9-90621aaa7a8a/scratchpad/cr-ui/`:
- UI-1: `sec/undo-code-390.png` and `shots/blocks/kinds-390-03.png`; counts in `wraps.json`.
- UI-2: `sec/gates-practice-1440.png` and `sec/agents-six-1440.png`; measurements in `blank.json`.
- UI-3: `heroes/S-c-390.png`, `heroes/S-c-1440a.png` and `heroes/S-c-1440b.png`; per-page numbers in `contrast/rows.json`.
- UI-4: `sec/tdd-print.pdf` and `sec/S-print.png`.
- All other screenshots are under `shots/`, `shots/blocks/` and `states/`.
